title: libpod: do not pass LISTEN_* environment to conmon
body:
When podman is socket-activated, it gets LISTEN_FDS descriptors to the OCI runtime via --preserve-fds, and sets LISTEN_* variables in the container spec. Yet, LISTEN_* also end up in conmon's environment, and from there, in the OCI runtime's one.

crun adds LISTEN_FDS to --preserve-fds, and thus keeps twice as many fds as podman intended.

conmon (since commit f5c42e2) also sums LISTEN_FDS and --preserve-fds, closing its own sync pipe, so the container fails to start.

Do not pass LISTEN_* to conmon, as podman already does everything needed to pass the sockets to the container.

Fixes: 7ade972102 ("libpod: pass entire environment to conmon")
Fixes: https://github.com/containers/conmon/issues/709

Related: containers/conmon#709, containers/conmon#711, containers/crun#2419.

#### Does this PR introduce a user-facing change?

```release-note
none
```

comments.body: CI is broken for unclear reasons unrelated to this PR
